handoff.objective: Faithful executable arithmetic, fixture/RNG/control pipeline, launch authenticity and canonical outcome custody
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Exact independent implementation or mathematical readiness on the owned joint, without scientific execution.
constraints: Not alone in the codebase; write only your exact declared report/check artifacts. Never edit producer code, experiments, ledger, queues or another reviewer output; no commits or pushes.
Independent fresh session separate from producer. Do not read the parent conversation or other reviewer reports, including through git history. Record exact read paths and any blindness deviation.

Zero scientific runs: do not generate the frozen scientific fixtures, run the collision census, run the experimental control matrix or gather research measurements. At most20 total synthetic/mock test-case executions per reviewer, each<=10seconds, aggregate<=120wall/CPU seconds. Record actual commands/output/counts; no broad suite.

Report only owned joints as PASS, NEEDS_CORRECTION or UNCHECKABLE with exact scope; no whole-claim verdict, hypothesis status, mathematical evidence, run validity or launch approval. Absence of a test failure is not completion proof.
No Bedrock, fallback, degraded inference or fabricated model probe. Native configured review-adversarial resolves gpt-5.6-sol at xhigh; no fresh API model verification is asserted.

Read the producer only at the bound snapshot or after verifying exact SHA256. Review all executable obligations; the blind rederivation task owns the independent mathematical formula, so report implementation conformance without claiming to have seen that derivation.
completion_gate: Every owned joint has a supported verdict, worked attack and exact scope.
All declared outputs exist; commands and checks are actual and within bounds.
Read-scope/blindness attestation names actual inputs and any deviation; no producer/status mutation.
Reports remain pending Coordinator snapshot and adjudication.

review_plan.claim_under_review: Producer reports implemented_pending_independent_review, protocol_complete:false and archive_pending:true for the prospective EXP-ECDLP-651b94 implementation; determine the exact remaining barriers before scientific launch. No empirical or complexity claim is under review.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Before reviewer dispatch: the Coordinator expects at least one substantive correction before measurement. Several controls and runner obligations were implemented only after parent inspection and received static checks, not a new test pass. Likely weak points are manifest/failure semantics, partial-data preservation, cancellation/RSS enforcement, exact RNG/panel coverage and the distinction between formula correctness and faithful implementation.

joints.joint: Faithful executable arithmetic, fixture/RNG/control pipeline, launch authenticity and canonical outcome custody
joints.attack_plan: Trace every frozen obligation to executable code. Use synthetic finite transition tables and mock I/O/runtime/locks to challenge conjugation, reset maps, zero-success collisions, forged/stale lock rejection, resource/cancellation classification, partial output retention and manifest schema. Check producer hash/plan bindings at the exact snapshot. Report executable counterexamples or precise source-line defects, not merely missing metadata. Do not execute the experimental fixture/census/control matrix.
joints.breaking_artifact: A reproducible bounded synthetic check failure or exact code path that violates an identified frozen obligation; separate untested gaps from proven defects.

joints.joint: Blind mathematical derivation of charged useful-collision/null cost and finite all-coordinate decision rules
joints.attack_plan: From the frozen quantity statement and parameters only, derive the cost and pooled-null denominators, coefficient recovery sign and verification charge, unavailable-cell rule and the all-u positive/negative/inconclusive conjunction. Construct unequal-success-count and zero-success synthetic tables where averaging arm ratios gives the wrong comparison. Explain finite-panel scope and which group relabeling can preserve the result. Do not read producer implementation, notes, tests, or report.
joints.breaking_artifact: An explicit arithmetic table, coefficient identity, or quantifier counterexample that changes a claimed comparison or branch.

objects: Zero successful collisions with positive work, for which finite charged cost is undefined.
Unequal-success null arms whose mean cost differs from total work divided by total successes.
One missing heldout cell or one coordinate arm that fails the effect threshold, for which a complete-panel positive verdict is false.
proves_too_much.failure_signature: The derivation must refuse finite gain for zero successes and refuse a positive complete-panel verdict for missing or failed arms; use pooled work/success counts.

blind_rederivation.quantity: Coefficient recovery, transition+verification group operations per useful collision, matched-null pooled cost, d=log(Cnull/Ccoordinate), and the finite three-coordinate decision conjunction.
blind_rederivation.parameters: Four distinct frozen curves;16seeds606300..606315;8heldout seeds606308..606315;u=1,2,3;all r starts;7null arms/cell;32heldout cells/u;effect threshold log(1.20). Exact frozen statement in spectral-blind-input.yaml and original specification.

review_plan.scope_limit: Implementation admission review only; no hypothesis promotion, goal closure, experimental run or mathematical validity attestation is authorized.
